customers_state_enabled_description: The customer activated an account in the store.
customers_state_disabled_description: The customer has no store account, for example after a guest checkout.
customers_state_invited_description: The store invited the customer to create an account.
customers_state_declined_description: The customer declined the store’s account invitation.
customers_state_unknown_description: The source didn’t report an account state.
customers_access_not_granted: {source} hasn’t granted access to customers. Reconnect it to see its customers here.
customers_access_reconnect_shopify: {source} was connected before Luma could read customers. Reconnect it to share customers with Luma.
customers_list_search_placeholder: Name, email, phone, or source ID…
customers_list_unresolved: This customer isn’t in Luma yet. Data sync imports customers from connected stores, and they appear here after the next sync.
customers_access_lost: You don’t have access to customers in this workspace. Ask a workspace admin for permission to view customers.
customers_list_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} customer} other {{count, number} customers}}
customers_empty_unmatched_body: Try another name, email address, phone number, or source.
customers_empty_not_shared_body: Customers appear here once a connected store shares them with Luma.
customers_empty_importing_body: Luma is reading customers from your store. They appear here as they’re imported.
customers_empty_body: No connected store has reported a customer yet. New customers appear here after the next sync.
customers_detail_offline: You’re offline. This customer’s details may be out of date.
customers_detail_missing_body: This customer isn’t in this workspace. The store may have asked Luma to erase their data, or Luma removed them after they were missing from their source for 30 days.
customers_detail_refresh_failed: Luma couldn’t refresh this customer. The details below may be out of date.
customers_detail_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load this customer. Check your connection and try again.
customers_history_description: Orders that Luma imported from {source} for this customer. An order linked across sources appears once. Open an order to see its sources, open issues, and Luma’s actions.
customers_history_empty_body: Orders appear here after data sync imports orders that the source attributes to this customer.
customers_history_access: You need access to orders to see this customer’s orders.
customers_history_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load this customer’s orders.
customers_history_refresh_failed: Luma couldn’t refresh this customer’s orders. The list below may be out of date.
customers_history_page_expired: This page of orders no longer matches the sort order.
customers_contact_note: {store} shares contact details and addresses only when Luma is approved to receive protected customer data.
customers_contact_note_generic: The store shares contact details and addresses only when Luma is approved to receive protected customer data.
customers_source_note: Each store and ERP keeps its own customers. Luma never merges customers across sources by name or email address.
customers_gone_notice: {source} no longer has this customer. Luma removes customers that stay missing for 30 days, with their order links. If {source} reports the customer again, they stay.
customers_field_country_description: The country of the address the source shares. Unknown when the source shares no address.
customers_field_last_order_description: When the customer last placed an imported order. Needs access to orders.
customers_field_missing_description: A complete read of the source no longer found the customer.
customers_field_contact_shared_descripti: Whether the source shares the customer’s name, email address and phone number.
customers_preview_unavailable: The customer’s details couldn’t be loaded.
customers_erase_description: Luma removes this customer’s profile, order addresses and the inbox messages to or from them. This can’t be undone.
customers_erase_scope: Message text, attachments, addresses, names and subjects are removed, and mailbox rules for their address; unsent replies to them are withheld. Later imports skip this customer. Data in the connected system is not changed.
customers_erase_failed: The customer couldn’t be erased. Try again.
customers_erase_forbidden: You no longer have permission to erase customers.
customers_erase_preview_failed: Luma couldn’t check what will be erased.
